# oddsignal.kr

Source of the [Oddsignal](https://oddsignal.kr) company website.

Oddsignal is a Korean company (founded September 2026) building **Shortforme**, a short-form ad tool for small brands, and running **Hightemp**, an online fitness education brand.

- Static site: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step
- Languages: Korean and English (toggle in the header)
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages
- Demo of Shortforme: https://shortforme.oddsignal.kr
